title: geranium cinereum subsp. cazorlense
intro: Geranium cinereum subsp. cazorlense, commonly known as the Iberian cranesbill, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress, due to its reported health benefits, including antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Geranium cinereum subsp. cazorlense include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate anxiety, and provide relief from muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
